decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The event is permitted between set up from 1st September 2025 and 19th September 2025 inclusive of site construction and demolition.

Reason: This permission is being granted on the basis of it being a temporary event.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Cover letter dated on 25 March 2025, 728-P-02, 762-P-01, 762-P-03, 762-P-04, 762-P-05, 762-P-06, 762-P-07, 762-P-08, Planning, Design, Environment & Heritage Statement, Ground Management Plan, Event Management Plan, Communications document, Ecological Appraisal, Ground and Park Landscape Protection, Maintenance, and Restoration Plan, A Comprehensive Restoration Plan � Post Events, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan Statement, Technical Note - Impact on TfL services and Technical Note � Waste Management Plan. Received: 27/03/2025; 762-P-08 (with markup) and Tree Protection Measures for Gunnersbury Park Festivals & Events. Received: 09/07/2025 Sound Management Plan Revision P02. Received: 29/07/2025; Construction Traffic Management Plan 2203-087/CTMP/04A. Received: 04/08/2025].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The uses and operational structures hereby approved shall only be operational between 12:00 � 22:30 on Friday 12th September and Saturday 13th September and between 11:00 � 22:00 on Sunday 14th September.

Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residential neighbours, in accordance with policies EC2, CC1 and CC2 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 4 - The Delivery and Servicing Management Plan shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved Construction Traffic Management Plan, any alterations or amendments must be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, in the interests of road safety in accordance with Policy EC2 of the Hounslow Local Plan.

Condition : 5 - The vehicular and pedestrian accesses shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved Transport Assessment and Travel Plan, any alterations or amendments must be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, in the interests of road safety in accordance with Policy EC2 of the Hounslow Local Plan.

Condition : 6 - The cycle storage units referred to in the approved plans shall be installed and made available for use prior to the first event and the spaces shall be available throughout the duration of the event.

Reason: To ensure the adequate provision of cycle spaces, in the interests of sustainable transport and in accordance with Policy EC2 of the Hounslow Local Plan.

Condition : 7 - Floodlighting hereby approved shall only be operational 08:00 - 23.30 and turned off at all other times, except for that required for security and safety purposes. Floodlighting will take into consideration the location of and proximity to local residential premises.

Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residents, in accordance with Policies CC1 and CC2 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 8 - Trees and landscape shall be protected in accordance with the hereby approved Ground and Park Landscape Protection, Maintenance, and Restoration Plan and Tree protection Measures, any alterations or amendments must be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance and character of Gunnersbury Park and the ecology, in accordance with Policies CC4, GB1, GB2, GB7 and GB9 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 9 - The applicant shall keep a photo record and site conditions report for before, during and after the time limit specified in Condition 1, and on conclusion of the events hereby approved shall, make provision for the landowner to complete the necessary remediation to return the site to its pre-event state as a minimum in accordance with the details set out in the submitted document and supporting information. (save for any wear and tear as identified in the lease agreement). A report shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority within 6-months after the event to confirm that the habitats and condition identified during the approved Ecological Appraisal report have been retained following the temporary event.

Reason: To safeguard the sporting use of the park and retain its openness, in accordance with Policies CC4, GB1, GB2, GB7 and GB9 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 10 - The event shall be carried out in accordance with the sound management plan hereby approved, or such other protocol as agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority, and shall be carried out in accordance with the details set out in the submitted document and supporting information.

Reason: To safeguard neighbours living conditions, in line with Policy CC2 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 11 - The event shall be carried out in accordance with the events management documents pertaining to crowd management, staggered movements and conducts of guests contained within the Communications and Site Management, Event Management Plan and Transport Assessment.

Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residents, in line with Policy CC2 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 12 - The event shall be carried out in accordance with Waste Management Plan hereby approved, any alterations or amendments must be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding residents, in line with Policy CC2 of the Local Plan.
description: Temporary change of use of area of Gunnersbury Park for the staging of a three-day music event to be held on 12th, 13th and 14th September 2025. Set-up from 1st September 2025 and clearance by 19th September 2025. Including erection of associated temporary structures, ancillary concessions and facilities.
